attchmntText: Simplex Infrastructures Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Simplex Infrastructure Limited submitted newspaper publications of its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and six months ended 30th September 2026. The results were published in Financial Express and Ekdin on 11th November 2026. The company also announced that the Annual General Meeting will be held on 15th December 2026. The meeting will consider the adoption of financial statements and the reappointment of retiring directors. The meeting will be conducted through video conferencing. Shareholders can cast their votes electronically from 21st November 2026 to 23rd November 2026. The electronic voting period is from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM. The record date for voting is 10th November 2026. The company confirmed its registered office address in Kolkata. The notice for the meeting was issued on 11th November 2026.

attchmntText: Simplex Infrastructures Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Simplex Infrastructures Limited filed a statement on deviations or variations regarding the proceeds of its preferential issue for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company raised a total of Rs. 281.59 Crores, comprising Rs. 262.84 Crores from equity and Rs. 18.75 Crores from the conversion of warrants. The monitoring agency is M/s Care Ratings Limited. The report confirms there is no deviation or variation in the use of funds raised. The Audit Committee reviewed the statement and recorded no comments. The auditors also recorded no comments. The funds were raised on 29th May 2025 and 21st July 2025. The filing was submitted to the National Stock Exchange of India, BSE Limited, and Calcutta Stock Exchange Limited on 10th November 2026.

attchmntText: Submission of Monitoring Agency Report for quarter ended 30-06-2026
voiceSummary: Simplex Infrastructures Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 regarding the preferential issue of equity shares and convertible warrants aggregating Rs. 423.69 crore. Care Ratings Limited issued the report on 10 November 2026. The monitoring agency observed no deviation from the objects of the issue. Utilization of proceeds covered payments to subcontractors, suppliers, salary expenses, statutory payments, bank guarantee margins, bank charges, and administrative costs. The company is rated CARE D INC due to ongoing delays in debt servicing obligations as of June 30, 2026. The balance warrant conversion price is lower than the market price, making warrants in the money, though further market declines may hinder conversion. Unutilized funds are held in fixed deposits with Punjab National Bank.

attchmntText: Simplex Infrastructures Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Simplex Infrastructures Limited held a Board Meeting on 10th November 2026. The Board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended 30th September 2026. The results include standalone and consolidated figures. The company executed a Master Restructuring Agreement with NARCL. Non-assigned debts were settled after the agreement. The auditor reported no material misstatements in the financial statement. The statement covers thirteen joint operations. Revenue for the six months ended 30th September 2026 was 36,566 lakhs. Net profit after tax was 3,561 lakhs. Total assets stood at 358,934 lakhs as of 30th September 2026. The board also approved a monitoring agency report by Care Ratings Limited. A statement on deviations regarding preferential issue proceeds was reviewed by the Audit Committee. The meeting concluded at 6:30 p.m.
